transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this preflight meeting started. We've got the fan Q&A scheduled for 7 to 8 PM tonight on the festival platform, and the current draft has the featured guest segment from 7:00 to 7:30, then audience questions, with a sponsor message near the end. Before I lock the production package, I need each of you — technical, talent, and sponsorship leads — to report any confirmed constraints or changes. Who wants to go first?
